in_hebrew.name: פאקסון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'pax', meaning peace, and 'on', meaning one. This name could be derived from the Hebrew word 'Shalom', meaning peace, with the addition of the suffix 'on' to indicate 'one who is'.

in_greek.name: Πάξων
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'pax', meaning peace. This name could be derived from the Greek name 'Paxas', which is derived from the word 'pax', meaning peace.

in_latin.name: Paxonius
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'pax', meaning peace, and the suffix 'onius', indicating 'belonging to' or 'having the quality of'. This name could be derived from the Latin name 'Paxsonius' or 'Paxio'.
